scope: Later-quantum mode of the common deployment experiment, stages LQ-1 and LQ-2 of the later-quantum design (profile LQ: Beacon-side post-run reveal, deviation D6). LQ-1: finish snapshot ghost, run-phase handler, reveal, post-run interface with its own budgets, later game, snap_erase, post-phase frame lemma and run-phase event transfer. LQ-2: compileLater with the finish pre-read, terminal field reads and forwarded post phase, merge_fields, CE-COMPILE-L at native, game and annotated-source level, budget transport with the field-read caps and the budget-free absence of KEM reads.

    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (identityIndex : Nat)
    (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode) (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (runtime : A) :
    (fun outcome => (outcome.1.map fun result => (result.1, result.2.1, (result.2.2.1, result.2.2.2.2)), outcome.2)) <$>

exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLater.later_classical_eve:
theorem later_classical_event (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (identityIndex : Nat)
    (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode) (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X)
    (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (event : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) → Bool)
    (invariant : ∀ created ledger state result, Caches state result →
      event (some (created, (ledger, result))) = event (some (created, (ledger, state))))
    (runtime : A) :
    𝒟[(fun outcome => event (outcome.1.map fun result => (result.1, (result.2.2.1, result.2.2.2.2)))) <$>
        (laterGame setup codec checks route ensureInit identityIndex bounds mode first second).run runtime] =
      𝒟[(fun outcome => event (outcome.1.map fun result => (result.1, result.2.2))) <$>
        (PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game setup codec checks route ensureInit identityIndex bounds mode first).run runtime]

exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLater.later_frame:
theorem later_frame (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (start : PqxdhDeploymentNative.State KemSK) (result : Out × LaterState KemSK)
    (supported : result ∈ support (laterExec setup codec checks route serverSeed bounds mode first second start)) :
    ∃ run ∈ support ((simulateQ (laterHandler setup codec checks route serverSeed bounds) (asModeO mode first)).run
        (Ledger.empty, (Snap.empty, start))),
      result.2.1 = run.2.1 ∧ result.2.2.1 = run.2.2.1 ∧ Caches run.2.2.2 result.2.2.2

exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.snap_step:
theorem snap_step (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) (query : Spec.Domain) (snap : Snap)
    (copies : Local) (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK)
    (inv : PqxdhDeploymentCompileStep.Inv setup codec copies native) :
    Prod.map id (fun state : (Snap × Local) × PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK => (state.1.1, merge state.1.2 state.2)) <$>
        (compiledSnapImpl setup codec checks route serverSeed query).run ((snap, copies), native) =
      (snapImpl setup codec checks route serverSeed query).run (snap, merge copies native)
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.compile_snap:
theorem compile_snap_run {Result : Type} (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed)
    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec) (program : OracleComp Spec Result)
    (snap : Snap) (copies : Local) (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK) (good : Good setup codec copies native) :
    Prod.map id (fun state : (Snap × Local) × PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK => (state.1.1, merge state.1.2 state.2)) <$>
        (simulateQ (compiledSnapImpl setup codec checks route serverSeed) program).run ((snap, copies), native) =
      (simulateQ (snapImpl setup codec checks route serverSeed) program).run (snap, merge copies native)
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.compile_post:

    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed)
    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec) (adversary : OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (copies : Local) (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK) (good : Good setup codec copies native) :
    (fun result => (result.1.1, merge result.1.2 result.2)) <$>
        (simulateQ (PqxdhRegistrationJointRevealSchedule.native setup codec checks serverSeed)
          ((simulateQ (compileImpl setup codec route) (simulateQ postEmbed adversary)).run copies)).run native =
      (simulateQ (postImpl setup codec checks serverSeed) adversary).run (merge copies native)
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.terminal_mer:
theorem terminal_merge (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) (snap : Snap) (copies : Local) (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK)

theorem compile_later_game (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (identityIndex : Nat)
    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out) (runtime : A) :
    mergeLater <$> (PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.native setup codec checks ensureInit identityIndex none
        (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second)).run runtime =
      (PqxdhDeploymentLater.laterGame setup codec checks route ensureInit identityIndex bounds mode first second).run
        runtime

theorem compile_later_source (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool)
    (phase1 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase1ReadBack codec)
    (phase2 : PqxdhServerAuthNegativeControl.Phase2ReadBack codec) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (state : PqxdhRegistrationJointServerPrefix.State KemSK A) :
    (fun result => mergeLater (result.1.map PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.eraseOutcome, result.2.2)) <$>
        (PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.source setup codec checks ensureInit none
          (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second)).run state =
      (PqxdhDeploymentLater.laterGame setup codec checks route ensureInit state.1.1.seeds.length bounds mode first
        second).run state.2

theorem compile_later_bound (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (budget : Budget) (respects : budget.Respects first) (post : PostBudget)
    (postRespects : ∀ output reveal, post.Respects (second output reveal)) (kind : SourceKind) :
    (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second).IsQueryBoundP
      (fun request => sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) request = kind)
      (∑ core, laterCost kind core * runCap bounds budget core + readCost kind * runCap bounds budget 1 +
        ∑ postKind, cost kind (postCore postKind) * post.cap postKind)

theorem compile_later_reads (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (budget : Budget) (respects : budget.Respects first) (post : PostBudget)
    (postRespects : ∀ output reveal, post.Respects (second output reveal)) :
    (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second).IsQueryBoundP
        (fun request => sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) request = .inr 0) budget.create ∧
      (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second).IsQueryBoundP
        (fun request => sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) request = .inr 1) 0 ∧
      (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second).IsQueryBoundP
        (fun request => sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) request = .inr 2) (budget.finish + budget.create) ∧
      (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second).IsQueryBoundP
        (fun request => sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) request = .inr 3) (budget.finish + budget.create)

theorem compile_later_no_kem (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out) :
    (compileLater setup codec route bounds mode first second).IsQueryBoundP
      (fun request => sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) request = .inr 1) 0

exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.Captured:
structure Captured where
  prekey : Option ScalarBytes
  oneTime : Option ScalarBytes
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.capture:
def capture (snap : Snap) (index : Nat) (prekey oneTime : Option (Value KemSK)) : Snap :=
  Function.update snap index ⟨(scalarOf prekey).or (snap index).prekey, (scalarOf oneTime).or (snap index).oneTime⟩
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.snapshotAt:
def snapshotAt (snap : Snap) (owners : List (PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK)) : Option Nat → Snap
  | none => snap
  | some index => capture snap index (fieldOf owners index .prekey) (fieldOf owners index .oneTime)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.Revealed:
structure Revealed where
  identity : IdentitySeed
  prekey : Option ScalarBytes
  oneTime : Option ScalarBytes
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.revealAt:
def revealAt (owners : List (PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK)) (snap : Snap) (index : Nat) : Option Revealed :=
  (owners[index]?).map (revealed snap index)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.revealOf:
def revealOf (owners : List (PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK)) (snap : Snap) : Reveal :=
  (List.range owners.length).filterMap (revealAt owners snap)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.PostQuery:
inductive PostQuery where
  | hmac (key : PqxdhSecretInputKdf.HmacBlock) (message : Pqxdh.Bytes)
  | hash (bytes : Pqxdh.Bytes)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.PostBudget:
structure PostBudget where
  coin : Nat
  hmac : Nat
  hash : Nat
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.postImpl:
noncomputable def postImpl (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) : QueryImpl PostSpec (StateT (PqxdhDeploymentNative.State KemSK) ProbComp)
  | .inl coin => StateT.lift (unifSpec.query coin : ProbComp _)
  | .inr (.hmac key message) => PqxdhDeploymentNative.onNative
      (PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.handler setup codec checks serverSeed (.inr (.hmac key message)))
  | .inr (.hash bytes) => PqxdhDeploymentNative.onNative
      (PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.handler setup codec checks serverSeed (.inr (.hash bytes)))
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.snapImpl:
noncomputable def snapImpl (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) :
    QueryImpl Spec (StateT (Snap × PqxdhDeploymentNative.State KemSK) ProbComp) := fun query state =>
  (fun result => (result.1, (snapshotAt state.1 state.2.native.owners (finishOwner query), result.2))) <$>
    (PqxdhDeploymentNative.handler setup codec checks route serverSeed query).run state.2
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.laterHandler:
noncomputable def laterHandler (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) (bounds : FreshBounds) :
    QueryImpl PqxdhDeploymentInterface.FullSpec (StateT (LaterState KemSK) ProbComp) :=
  ((snapImpl setup codec checks route serverSeed).mapStateTBase
    (ledgerImpl setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId bounds)).flattenStateT
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.laterExec:
noncomputable def laterExec (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (serverSeed : IdentitySeed) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out)
    (start : PqxdhDeploymentNative.State KemSK) : ProbComp (Out × LaterState KemSK) := do
  let run ← (simulateQ (laterHandler setup codec checks route serverSeed bounds) (asModeO mode first)).run
    (Ledger.empty, (Snap.empty, start))
  let post ← (simulateQ (postImpl setup codec checks serverSeed)
    (second run.1 (revealOf run.2.2.2.native.owners run.2.2.1))).run run.2.2.2
  pure (post.1, (run.2.1, (run.2.2.1, post.2)))
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.laterGame:
noncomputable def laterGame (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (identityIndex : Nat)
    (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode) (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X)
    (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out) :
    StateT A ProbComp (Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × Out × LaterState KemSK)) :=
  fun runtime => do
  let born ← (PqxdhLiveServerConstruction.construct setup.joint ensureInit identityIndex setup.serverKeyId none).run runtime
  match born.1 with
  | none => pure (none, born.2)
  | some created =>
    (fun result => (some (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.encode created, result), born.2)) <$>
      laterExec setup codec checks route created.seed bounds mode first second (PqxdhDeploymentNative.initial created)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLater.Caches:
def Caches (state result : PqxdhDeploymentNative.State KemSK) : Prop :=
  result = withCaches state result.native.shared.1 result.native.shared.2.ctx result.native.shared.2.ghost.touches
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.preRead:
def preRead (snap : Snap) : Option Nat → OracleComp (SourceSpec KemSK) Snap
  | none => pure snap
  | some index => do
      let prekey ← readQuery (KemSK := KemSK) index .prekey
      let oneTime ← readQuery (KemSK := KemSK) index .oneTime
      pure (capture snap index prekey oneTime)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.compileSnapI:
noncomputable def compileSnapImpl (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) :
    QueryImpl Spec (StateT (Snap × Local) (OracleComp (SourceSpec KemSK))) := fun query state => do
  let snap ← preRead state.1 (finishOwner query)
  let result ← (compileImpl setup codec route query).run state.2
  pure (result.1, (snap, result.2))
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.revealEntry:
def revealEntry (snap : Snap) (index : Nat) (identity prekey oneTime : Option (Value KemSK)) : Option Revealed :=
  match identity with
  | some (.identity seed) =>
      some ⟨seed, (scalarOf prekey).or (snap index).prekey, (scalarOf oneTime).or (snap index).oneTime⟩
  | _ => none
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.terminal:
def terminal (snap : Snap) : List Nat → OracleComp (SourceSpec KemSK) Reveal
  | [] => pure []
  | index :: rest => do
      let identity ← readQuery (KemSK := KemSK) index .identity
      let prekey ← readQuery (KemSK := KemSK) index .prekey
      let oneTime ← readQuery (KemSK := KemSK) index .oneTime
      let tail ← terminal snap rest
      pure ((revealEntry snap index identity prekey oneTime).toList ++ tail)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.compileLater:
noncomputable def compileLater (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode)
    (first : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (second : X → Reveal → OracleComp PostSpec Out) :
    OracleComp (SourceSpec KemSK) (Out × (Ledger × (Snap × Local))) := do
  let run ← (simulateQ (compileSnapImpl setup codec route)
    (wrap setup.source.crypto codec setup.serverKeyId bounds (asModeO mode first))).run (Snap.empty, Local.empty)
  let reveal ← terminal run.2.1 (List.range run.2.2.log.owners.length)
  let post ← (simulateQ (compileImpl setup codec route) (simulateQ postEmbed (second run.1.1 reveal))).run run.2.2
  pure (post.1, (run.1.2, (run.2.1, post.2)))
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.mergeLater:
def mergeLater (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.NativeOutcome KemSK
    (Out × (Ledger × (Snap × Local)))) × A) :
    Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × Out × LaterState KemSK) × A :=
  (outcome.1.map fun result =>
    (result.1, result.2.1.1, (result.2.1.2.1, (result.2.1.2.2.1, merge result.2.1.2.2.2 result.2.2))), outcome.2)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.runCap:
def runCap (bounds : FreshBounds) (budget : Budget) (core : Fin 12) : Nat :=
  ∑ full, PqxdhDeploymentCompileSecrecy.wrapCost bounds core full * budget.cap full
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.laterCost:
def laterCost (kind : SourceKind) (core : Fin 12) : Nat :=
  cost kind core + if core = 5 then unit kind (.inr 2) + unit kind (.inr 3) else 0
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentLaterCompile.readCost: def readCost (kind : SourceKind) : Nat := unit kind (.inr 0) + unit kind (.inr 2) + unit kind (.inr 3)

reveal_profile.revealed: For every Beacon created through create (every native owner, AnyPin Beacons included), in creation order: the Ed25519 identity seed; the X25519 prekey scalar; the X25519 one-time scalar of the successful bundle. Each scalar is the current field if the phase still holds it, otherwise the value captured by the finish snapshot before finish or abort erased it.
reveal_profile.derived_not_listed: The Beacon X25519 identity secret (production conversion of the seed); every Beacon-side DH output; the Server-side DH outputs of sessions with an honest Beacon whose response was published (Pqxdh.Crypto.dh_comm).
reveal_profile.deviation_D6: No Server secret is revealed: neither the Server Ed25519 identity seed (nor its X25519 conversion) nor any Server ephemeral scalar. Server-side DH outputs against points whose discrete logarithm the adversary does not know, and DH values of sessions whose ephemeral key was never published, stay unrevealed.
